class TTLCache:
    """A tiny time-to-live cache. All times are plain ints (seconds)."""

    def __init__(self, ttl):
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._data = {}

    def put(self, key, value, now):
        """Store value under key, stamped at time now."""
        self._data[key] = (value, now)

    def get(self, key, now):
        """Return the value if present and not expired, else None.

        A value is expired when now - t >= ttl (at exactly ttl it is expired).
        """
        if key not in self._data:
            return None
        value, t = self._data[key]
        if now - t > self.ttl:
            return None
        return value

import os
import sys
import unittest

from ttlcache import TTLCache


class TTLCacheContractTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_value_is_fresh_just_before_ttl(self):
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        cache.put("k", "v", now=10)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("k", now=14), "v")  # age 4 < 5

    def test_value_is_fresh_at_age_zero(self):
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        cache.put("k", "v", now=10)

    def test_value_expired_at_exactly_ttl(self):

        cache.put("k", "v", now=10)

        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        cache.put("k", "v", now=10)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("k", now=16))  # age 6 > 5: expired

    def test_absent_key_returns_none(self):
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("missing", now=0))

        cache = TTLCache(ttl=1)

        self.assertEqual(cache.get("k", now=0), "v")   # age 0: fresh
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("k", now=1))        # age == ttl: expired

    def test_put_refreshes_existing_key(self):
        cache = TTLCache(ttl=5)
        cache.put("k", "old", now=0)
        cache.put("k", "new", now=10)
        self.assertEqual(cache.get("k", now=13), "new")
        self.assertIsNone(cache.get("k", now=15))


if __name__ == "__main__":
